summary: AUNA S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its 1Q26 financial results. The filing is a routine earnings report with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other corporate event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are presented. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a domestic quarterly earnings release. The filing is purely operational and financial in nature, with no special-situation classification warranted.
